page_title: NIC 2-0 MAR | Nice v Marseille 26/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+3' Marseille failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90+3' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Pol Lirola (Marseille).
90+3' The resulting set piece from Nice is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' A dangerous looking corner kick from Jonathan Clauss (Nice) is cleared to safety by the defence.

90' That's unlucky! Tom Louchet (Nice) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared. It will be a corner kick for Nice.
89' Although Darryl Bakola (Marseille) is just on the bench, Eric Wattellier has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
88' Franck Haise has decided to make a change. Tanguy Ndombele (Nice) replaces Baptiste Santamaria.
88' Substitution. Gaetan Laborde makes his way off the pitch and Tom Louchet (Nice) comes on as his replacement.
85' Quentin Merlin (Marseille) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
82' Jonathan Rowe (Marseille) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
81' Here is a change. Mohamed-Ali Cho is going off and Franck Haise gives the last tactical orders to Badredine Bouanani (Nice).
80' Eric Wattellier blows his whistle and it's Moise Bombito (Nice) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
75' Substitution. Luis Henrique makes way for Bilal Nadir (Marseille).
75' Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and has an effort on goal. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies inches high over the bar.
73' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Youssouf Ndayishimiye (Nice) was quite harsh and Eric Wattellier didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
72' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Marseille.

71' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Marseille) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal from a mid-range free kick, but the ball is blocked by the defensive wall. Marseille force a corner. They send men into the box.
69' Marseille can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
67' Ali Abdi comes off the pitch to be replaced by Moise Bombito (Nice).
64' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Marseille comes to nothing.
63' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Marseille) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
63' Pol Lirola (Marseille) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
63' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) is forced to stop his forward run after being caught in an offside position by the linesman.
61' It's time for a substitution. Jonathan Rowe (Marseille) comes on in place of Valentin Rongier.
61' A substitution has been made. Lilian Brassier is replaced by Pol Lirola (Marseille).
61' Roberto De Zerbi has decided to substitute Neal Maupay and he is replaced by Robinio Vaz (Marseille).
58' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Mason Greenwood (Marseille), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the right post.
57' Adrien Rabiot (Marseille) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
55' Adrien Rabiot (Marseille) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot towards the middle of the net, but Marcin Bulka is alert and denies him.
54' Marseille take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
51' 2 - 0 Goal - 2:0! Evann Guessand laid the ball off to Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice), who shot from close range into the bottom right corner, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
49' Luis Henrique (Marseille) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
47' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
47' Adrien Rabiot (Marseille) finds his teammate inside the box with a sweet pass. However, Michael Murillo wasn't able to finish and lost the ball.
46' The whistle blows and Eric Wattellier starts the second half.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' It looks like Valentin Rongier (Marseille) saw red with that tackle. Eric Wattellier won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
45+1' The resulting corner from Jonathan Clauss (Nice) comes to nothing.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
44' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) takes the corner but it's cleared.
44' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Marseille) sends a cross into the box, but Marcin Bulka comes off his line to gather the ball.
43' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) receives a slide-rule pass inside the box and has just the keeper to beat. His shot low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and Geronimo Rulli easily makes the save.
40' Quentin Merlin (Marseille) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

40' Valentin Rongier (Marseille) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the roof of the net. Marcin Bulka is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save. Corner kick. Marseille will have an opportunity.
38' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
36' This would have been a magnificent goal from Gaetan Laborde (Nice), who collected the ball inside the box and prodded a first-time shot on goal that flew just narrowly wide of the left post.
35' Baptiste Santamaria (Nice) jumps into a tackle and Eric Wattellier signals a foul.
33' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 1:2.
32' Nice have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
29' The ball is cleared after Evann Guessand (Nice) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out of play. Nice are awarded a corner kick.
27' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) attempts to find Adrien Rabiot, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
27' Evann Guessand (Nice) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement.
24' A pass by Youssouf Ndayishimiye (Nice) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
24' Eric Wattellier blows the whistle, Leonardo Balerdi (Marseille) is penalised for a foul.
18' A pass into the box finds Adrien Rabiot (Marseille) unmarked. He carefully places a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Marcin Bulka denies him.

15' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and drills a nice strike from a promising distance towards the middle of the goal. Marcin Bulka has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
14' Ali Abdi (Nice) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
13' The corner is swung in but Marseille can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
13' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Marseille) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
12' Leonardo Balerdi (Marseille) fails to connect properly with the corner kick and plants his header way over the bar from the centre of the box.
11' Quentin Merlin (Marseille) will deliver the corner kick.
11' Quentin Merlin (Marseille) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
8' Luis Henrique (Marseille) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
7' 1 - 0 Goal! Evann Guessand (Nice) picks up a pass and gets to the edge of the box before clipping a brilliant lob over the goalkeeper and into the empty net. He makes it 1:0.
6' Quentin Merlin (Marseille) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
5' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
3' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
